Google Announces New Gemini App Tools for Small Business Owners

2026-10-27 · AI-assisted, source-attributed report

According to an official Google blog post, new Gemini app tools are being introduced for small business owners under the banner "Your brand, your tools, all in one place."

The official source excerpt highlights three specific features designed to help business owners. First, users can "Create image styles for your brand." Second, the platform allows users to "Customize Gemini with apps and skills." Finally, business owners can "Create content with templates."

These features are part of Google's latest updates aimed at providing centralized tools for branding, customization, and content creation within the Gemini application.
